lines: Ye mojiza bhi mohabbat kabhi dikhaye mujhe
couplets.en: May love show me this miracle someday.

lines: Ke sang tujh pe gire

lines: Woh jab bhi chahe bade shauq se jalaye mujhe

lines: Dagha kare woh kisi se to sharm aaye mujhe
couplets.en: If he betrays anyone, the shame falls on me.

lines: Woh mehrban hai to iqrar kyun nahin karta

couplets.en: If he cares for me, why does he keep silent, and if he doubts me, let him try me a hundred times.

lines: Azmaye mujhe
